axes.label: Configured enemy output and healing modifiers
Delayed threat transfer to one ally

notes: Shiv removes Ravenous; Kick handles Piercing Hiss, Toxic Atrophy, and Mass Envenom, while Blind only delays a susceptible cast without a school lockout.
Cloak is self-only protection from Ritual of the Fang or eligible debuffs; Shroud depends on the planned route.
Vanish can cancel selected beams or free the Rogue from Bloodthorn Roots, but it is not modeled as generic root or Magic removal.
The guide identifies no Enrage target; Cloak remains self-only.
Shiv removes Mother's Wrath or Bestial Wrath; Cloak can remove Toxic Spores from the Rogue.
Vanish can escape the guide-named Glacial Tomb targeting, while Kick and single-target stops cover eligible casts.
Shiv removes Back to Work or Fel Rage and Kidney Shot controls susceptible first-boss targets.
Cloak or Vanish can cancel selected Drain Life or Fel Missiles targeting, but neither provides party dispel coverage.
Shiv removes Feral Rage, Bloodsurge, or Bolster, although removing an Enrage can be strategically wrong when its downside benefits the party.
Vanish can cancel selected Void Beam targeting; Kick remains the actual school lockout for deadly casts.
Vanish can cancel Latent Hex targeting and Cloak can remove eligible harmful spell effects from the Rogue.
The guide names no Enrage target; control remains single-target unless a separate talent changes its delivery.
Kick or a single-target stop covers Hex Volley, Unholy Mending, Bind Soul, Wretched Discharge, or Hex when susceptible.
No guide-backed Enrage interaction is asserted; Shroud remains route-planning utility rather than automatic skip coverage.
Vanish can cancel selected Lightning Torrent targeting and Cloak can remove Lightning Rod or high Cold Claws stacks from the Rogue.
Shiv has no Enrage target here; Blind can delay Ice Shield or Flaming Barrage but does not school-lock.

recommendations: Kick can stop one orb, but Rogue has no baseline area crowd control and cannot cover a full wave alone.
Swap immediately to the priority enemy; Rogue supplies damage rather than a special group removal tool.
Sprint and other mobility help collect nearby orbs without abandoning the priority target.
Cloak of Shadows or Vanish can remove the Rogue's own application and Crimson Vial helps heal the absorb. Do not pre-immune the application when doing so would reduce the group's obtainable benefit.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of JustGuy's Patch 12.1.0 Outlaw Rogue Mythic+ guidance. Its dungeon sections are comparatively compact; shared class interactions are constrained by canonical mechanics and the other current Rogue guides. WHELP stores compact recommendations and IDs rather than copied guide prose or talent strings.
